problem:
Title: Absolute Net Convergence Equivalent to Absolute Convergence

Let $V$ be a [[Definition:Banach Space|Banach space]].

Let $\sequence {v_n}_{n \mathop \in \N}$ be a [[Definition:Sequence|sequence]] of elements in $V$.

Let $r \in \R_{\mathop \ge 0}$

Then the following two statements are equivalent:

:$(1): \quad$ the [[Definition:Generalized Sum|generalized sum]] $\ds \sum \set {v_n: n \in \N}$ is [[Definition:Absolute Net Convergence|absolutely net convergent]] to $r$
:$(2): \quad$ the [[Definition:Series|series]] $\ds \sum_{n \mathop = 1}^\infty v_n$ is [[Definition:Absolutely Convergent Series|absolutely convergent]] to $r$
